Devon: repro'd a perf cliff in kernel selection on flash v3 when head_dim % 8 != 0 + seq_len ~512 with causal + kv-prefetch on SM86. Investigating. :thinking:
Maria: which benchmark? GCP SM86? link?
Devon: quick facts: model=redwood-13b, batch=1, seq=512, head_dim=51, causal=true, kv_prefetch=on, hw=SM86. Kernel picker log:
```
kernel_picker: probe v3_causal_head_remap -> reject (unaligned head=51)
kernel_picker: try sdpa_flash_v2 -> select (non-causal fallback)
kernel_picker: fallback -> sdpa_slowpath (L2 spill)
```
Andrew: sounds like the head remap heuristic is too strict. We've seen headslice remap step fail when head_dim%16 != 0.
Devon: profiling shows hot L2 store misses and extra memcpy during prefetch. Flame snippet:
```
L2_load_miss 42%
memcpy_kv_prefetch 21%
sdpa_slowpath 18%
flash_v3_kernel 5%
```
Karen: can you paste the `kernel_probe` output from the runtime (the JSON blob)?
Devon: pasted gist: https://priv.gist/abc123 (contains probe payload). TL;DR: probe score for flash_v3 is low because of prefetch alignment penalty.
ci-bot: perf/regression-checker: nightly-probe started for thread 2142023456
Maria: quick mitigation: disable kv_prefetch for causal requests with head_dim%8 != 0 until we have a patch. :eyes:
Andrew: prefer adding a remap padding path: pad heads to next multiple of 8 at the remap stage (no copy if pad <= 3). That gave +12% p99 before.
Devon: pushed local patch to kernel_picker heuristics that biases flash_v3 for seq in [256,1024] if head_dim%8 in [1,2,3], re-ran microbench -> p99 improved ~18% and throughput +6%. Perf trace: https://perf/reports/2142023456
Karen: I'll add an autotune grid to nightly: dims=[32,48,51,64], seq=[128,256,512,1024], causal in [true,false], prefetch in [on,off]. We can let the tuner pick thresholds.
Devon: add gating: autotune hysteresis=48h and rollout=false by default. Also need signal to disable remap on Dedicated for experiments.
Maria: assigning @Karen and @Andrew to follow up. I'll open an infra ticket for Dedicated cluster testing and add a note in release notes.
Andrew: will create a small benchmark script and run on SM86/SM90 tomorrow.
Devon: thanks all. If anyone sees strange slowdowns in canary, ping me. :thumbsup:
